en: A sepia-toned historical postcard depicting a large public square bordered by traditional European townhouses. At the center right stands a prominent building with a clock tower, likely the town hall. Several people can be seen walking or standing in the square. The image features text at the bottom identifying the location as 'Rochlitz i. Sa. Markt.' There are also visible business signs on the buildings, such as 'Kaffee Kirsten'.
